subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers continue with this branch as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback candidate after repair, or route the issue to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 after that candidate is refreshed?
rationale: The same bug has overlapping candidate PRs, this branch is conflicting, and the current head still has proof plus code-review blockers that automation cannot settle without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower upload-scope detector, action metadata preservation, conflict refresh, negative tests, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

options.title: Use the member candidate after refresh
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 becomes mergeable, proof-accepted, and covers the same three delivery paths.

options.title: Waive live proof deliberately
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept source-level proof, but the predicate, metadata, and conflict blockers still need repair.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower upload-scope detector, action metadata preservation, conflict refresh, negative tests, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat action and outbound media plumbing history makes this the strongest available routing signal for the canonical-fix choice.
